cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the bottle. The third elbow appears when you call it 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Liquid elbow. Count the drops; I'll mark an inch for each one.

reason: Give the novice actual handling support and turn rain directly into the missing elbow measurement; replace unrelated credentials/sleeve explanation with an invented but task-connected rule.
